repository_summary: Aspose.Cells FOSS for C++ is an open-source C++ library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks without requiring Microsoft Excel. It provides an Aspose.Cells-compatible API surface, supports .xlsx load/save from file paths and streams, and includes features like cell values, formulas, styles, conditional formatting, and more. The library is distributed under the MIT license and is available via NuGet as Aspose.cells.Cpp.FOSS. Installation is managed via CMake manifests.
